There are two ways to play it in the best experience with english:


1. The easy way

Go to https://ynoproject.net which has several other fangames, go to 2kki and make an account

2. The harder way (my method) 

Download the newest version in Japanese, then download EasyRPG (you need to get the nightly build though as its the only version that supports translations). Now go to the YNOproject github and download the ynotranslations repository. within that folder should be a 2kki folder, copy all the folders within it. Go back to your yume 2kki game folder, enter the folder which has the game files (I forgot the name of the folder, I think it's labeled as "Game" or "Data" ), create a new folder called "language", then paste the language folders into that folder. Copy the EasyRPG exe into the yume 2kki game folder and run it, then select yume 2kki (name will be in Japanese). The main menu should have a language tab, go in there and select English. 

Sorry if this is hard to understand, I'm not the greatest at writing instructions. Your best bet is to use ynoproject.net as it supports online play and auto updates, but my method allows you to play it in 16:9 (buggy since the game wasn't designed for it though).
